title: Expressing Doubt, Correcting, and Reaching Consensus
summary: Negotiating carefully, confirming or correcting, and making counterproposals.
whyItMatters: Productive consensus requires people to mark uncertainty, correct information transparently, identify shared goals, and make workable counterproposals.

mentalModel.title: Verify before opposing
mentalModel.content: Clarify the claim and evidence before deciding whether to doubt, correct, or disagree.

mentalModel.title: Consensus is an explicit package
mentalModel.content: State the shared point, remaining difference, agreed action, responsibility, and review point.

ruleBlocks.title: Express doubt proportionally
ruleBlocks.content: Use vorsichtig markers such as 'Ich bin nicht sicher, ob ...' or stronger correction only when evidence supports it.

ruleBlocks.title: Correct claim and record
ruleBlocks.content: Name the inaccurate point, provide the corrected information, and cite the basis.

ruleBlocks.title: Make a usable counterproposal
ruleBlocks.content: Preserve the shared goal while changing method, timing, or scope.

ruleBlocks.title: Confirm consensus precisely
ruleBlocks.content: Repeat what was agreed, who acts, and when the result will be reviewed.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Ich bin nicht sicher, ob diese Information stimmt.
Worauf bezieht sich diese Zahl genau?
Da liegt vermutlich ein Missverständnis vor.
In diesem Punkt stimme ich zu; beim Vorgehen sehe ich es anders.

tables.title: Consensus Workflow
rows: time and criterion for checking progress

patterns: Wir können uns darauf einigen, dass ...
sentenceStructure: Correct the information rather than embarrassing the speaker.
Link counterproposals to the shared goal.

comparisons.summary: The theme provides contested claims and civic decisions that require verification.
Advanced connectors explain how an agreement works and which alternatives were rejected.

examples.de: Ich bin nicht sicher, ob die Grafik die aktuelle Situation zeigt.
examples.en: I am not sure whether the chart shows the current situation.

examples.de: Da muss ich etwas korrigieren: Die Zahl stammt aus dem Vorjahr.
examples.en: I need to correct something there: the figure is from last year.

examples.de: Beim Ziel sind wir uns einig, aber der vorgeschlagene Zeitplan ist zu knapp.
examples.en: We agree on the goal, but the proposed schedule is too tight.

examples.de: Mein Gegenvorschlag wäre, das Projekt zunächst an zwei Schulen zu testen.
examples.en: My counterproposal would be to test the project at two schools first.

examples.de: Dann halten wir fest, dass wir die Quellen prüfen und am Freitag neu entscheiden.
examples.en: Then let us record that we will check the sources and decide again on Friday.

commonMistakes.wrong: Call a claim false before checking the evidence.
commonMistakes.correct: Match the strength of the correction to what is known.

commonMistakes.wrong: Reject a proposal without offering a path forward.
commonMistakes.correct: Connect a counterproposal to the shared objective.
Repeat action, owner, timing, and review criterion.

tips: Use a certainty scale from possible to disproven.
Write the shared goal before proposing changes.
Finish every negotiation with a read-back.
